intro: The Inner Sanctum centers on a perilous reconnaissance into the deepest chamber of the Shrine of Akir. After Valennia Stormfist and her strike force breached the sanctum amidst heavy fighting, an eerie silence fell over the area, prompting an urgent mission to discover if any survivors remain.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... Unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... If any of them are left.
I'll stay here and watch your back.
